[1/5] Player character (age, skills, abilities), research projects, and planetary outpost construction/production mechanics

impact_assessment.why: User requested a deeper simulation with a player character (abilities, age, skills) plus research and outpost mechanics.
impact_assessment.benefits: Persistent character progression, active abilities with cooldowns, a research tech tree that buffs simulation systems, and outposts that generate resources over ticks.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState save schema must stay backward compatible; dependency: none (stdlib); concurrency: engine lock preserved; state: legacy saves need deterministic defaults without RNG drift.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add defaulted models, engine clone support, and failing-first model/engine tests.
